response.text:
I can do that, but I need a few details and your explicit confirmation first — forwarding will share the thread’s senders, recipients, timestamps and any attachments with the target address.

Please confirm these items:

1) Exact recipient email address(es) for “finance group” (e.g., finance@company.com or a distribution list).  
2) Scope to forward:
   - entire thread (all messages),
   - only the latest message,
   - or specific messages (specify by sender/date).
3) Include attachments? (yes / no) — if yes, I will forward all attachments in the selected messages.  
4) Optional: add a cover note? If yes, paste the text to include.

When you’re ready, reply with a single confirmation like this (fill in the blanks):

Confirm: Forward “Q3 budget review” to [recipient email]; scope: [entire thread / latest / specific messages: …]; include attachments: [yes/no]; cover note: “[text or none]”.

I will not forward until I receive that explicit confirmation.
